title: Comb
reference: repeat 3 { forward forward turn_left F1(9) turn_left } def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward F1 forward } }
hints: Walk along the spine. At each tooth, turn in, let F1 go up and back, then turn on along the spine.
Main: repeat 3 of forward, forward, turn left, F1(9), turn left. F1 is the one from Four Arms.
